Alabama is no exception -- opponents of voting rights across the country feel threatened by increased voter participation.
They're scared that if every eligible voter takes part in our elections, they'll be kicked out of office. That's why they've been working for decades to pick and choose which votes count and disillusion potential voters about whether their vote really matters.
Team: Fuel our work to fight back with $25 or more right now to make every vote count and increase voter participation nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=090524_3&amount=25]

name: The Democratic National Committee
subject: If you have been waiting for the most impactful time to give. It’s today.
body:
Today is one of the most important days to give to help elect Democrats because the first ballots are being mailed to voters this week.
---
If you have been waiting for the most impactful time to make your first donation to the Democratic Party, we're here to tell you today is that day. Why today? Today is one of the most important days to give to help elect Democrats because the first ballots of this election are being mailed to voters this week. Some of the most important work we have to do as we get closer to Election Day is to persuade undecided voters to vote Democrat and to turn out Democrats to vote. That's our job. And we know with enough resources, we can do it. As a reminder, these early votes could determine not just control of the White House and Congress, but down-ballot races that make such a difference in your state. So yes. Today. Scars don’t define a person, but they do tell a part of one’s story. The scars that you see on my body are a result of an IED explosion while deployed in Afghanistan. I will always be a soldier at heart — but I am also so much more. I am a husband, a father, a business owner, and a follower of Jesus Christ. I’m running for Senate because I believe in America, and because I believe in answering the call to serve. I have lived a life of service and sacrifice. # [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1880%2E135344%2Es8myOB)

Friend -
If you were waiting for the perfect time to make your first donation to my campaign for Senate, not only is today the perfect day but there's also a very good reason as well.
Betsy DeVos.
If you're already familiar with her significant support for my opponent and are ready to chip in, please use this link to give:
**[https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/beat-devos](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240905-3-900&t=2&akid=1880%2E135344%2Es8myOB)**
Otherwise, let me go a little deeper ... including a very recent revelation about her designs on a role in a second Trump administration.
As Michiganders know, for decades the DeVos family’s #1 issue has been weakening Michigan's, and the country's, public education system. Betsy DeVos used Michigan as her petri dish before becoming Trump’s Secretary of Education, and one of his longest serving cabinet secretaries.
Much like our Republican opponent, Mike Rogers, she condemned Donald Trump after January 6, 2021. In Betsy DeVos’ case, she “resigned in protest” as Education Secretary, blaming his rhetoric on the insurrection -- just 13 days before the end of Trump’s term.
And like my current opponent who turned around and worked hard for Trump's endorsement, Betsy DeVos is now back -- and willing to serve in a second Trump administration.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240905-3-900&t=3&akid=1880%2E135344%2Es8myOB)
So what does that mean?
As if there weren't already a million reasons to defeat Donald Trump, there's now one more: keeping Betsy DeVos out of any role of prominence in Washington, D.C.
And there is no doing that without winning in Michigan.
The DeVos family has been some of the top supporters to opponents of mine in the past, and they've doubled down on this Senate race.
Mike Rogers' first FEC report in this race was filled with donations from a bunch of members of the DeVos family -- contributions totaling $46,200 all made on one single day. And just last week, Betsy DeVos herself was campaigning with Mike Rogers at a roundtable just a day before the primary election.
They are certainly not done with their support of my opponent.
On a positive note, the response to emails about the DeVos donations has raised far more than the DeVos family has contributed. But we have to keep going, because their family's unlimited wealth can impact this race in many more ways.
So in light of this news about Betsy DeVos' potential return to Washington, D.C. and her role in campaigning for my opponent, I am asking:
[**Can you contribute $3 directly to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan? I will put your donation made today in Betsy’s name right to work persuading the voters we need to win in Michigan this fall.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240905-3-900&t=4&akid=1880%2E135344%2Es8myOB)

body:
Help us kick off tomorrow's 2A Tour
| | | |
---
| | |
---
Hey Team Morse! Join our next Governor at [Shooters Outpost in Hooksett NH at 1PM tomorrow.](https://link.email.chuckmorsefornh.) Chuck Morse has always been a strong advocate for our Second Amendment Rights!
* **NRA Endorsement and Rating** : Morse proudly received an "A" rating from the National Rifle Association in 2024 and was endorsed by the NRA in 2022, underscoring his support for gun rights.
* **Legislative Actions** : As Senate President, Morse has been instrumental in passing legislation that supports gun rights. He drafted and supported bills like the 'Stand Your Ground' legislation and opposed measures like red flag laws, which he views as infringements on Second Amendment rights.
* **Second Amendment Coalition** : Recently, Morse announced a "Second Amendment Coalition" to back his gubernatorial campaign, highlighting his dedication to defending gun rights. This coalition includes various leaders from across New Hampshire who endorse Morse for his consistent support of the Second Amendment.
* **Public Statements** : Morse has publicly advocated for enforcing existing gun laws rather than adding more, suggesting a belief in the effectiveness of current regulations when properly enforced. He has also emphasized the importance of the Second Amendment in maintaining other constitutional freedoms.
* **Campaign Focus** : His campaign has made it clear that defending the Second Amendment is a key issue, positioning him as a staunch protector of gun rights against what he perceives as overreaches by those advocating for stricter gun control.

Chuck Morse's record and campaign focus shows he's committed to upholding and defending the Second Amendment, aligning himself closely with pro-gun rights advocacy groups and policies.

| BIG ANNOUNCEMENT ON MONDAY
---
|
# BREAKING THE SILENCE
---
|
Dear Friends & Supporters,
Today, I'm breaking my silence. Life has been exciting and busy.
During the past month, I've purchased and moved into my new home in Appomattox, begun campaigning in 10 counties for State Senate, successfully recovered from outpatient surgery for 3 hernias and married off our daughter. But now I'm back.
We have much catching up to do.
First up, let's talk about the 5th Congressional District, where I now live.
As many of you know, there will most likely be a special election this coming January 7, 2025 to replace John McGuire in the Virginia Senate.
Like many of you, I supported John McGuire for State Senate but supported Congressman Bob Good for Congress. Congressman Bob Good is one of the most effective conservatives we currently have in Congress. It didn't make sense to me to challenge a Republican who is doing a good job.
If you live in Senate District 10 and participated in the convention, you may remember that John McGuire asked me to introduce him.
I did.
At the time, I was honored to do so and even skipped a day of campaigning in my own district to help him win the seat.
Many of you voted for John because you trusted me. In the senate race, I believe John was the best candidate for state senate. However, in the primary for Congress, I believe Congressman Bob Good was the best candidate.
That said, John McGuire has been declared the winner and I will vote for our Republican nominee. Otherwise, we end up with a Democrat. Remember Democrat Congressman Tom Perriello who represented the 5th Congressional District?
I do.
Remember. If we lose the majority in the House, Democrats will be able to stack the committees so they are all dominated by Democrats and President Trump will not be able to accomplish his agenda to restore our country.
We must win the Congressional seat in District 5. By staying home or writing in the honorable Congressman Bob Good, we are handing not only this race over to a Democrat, but potentially handing over which party will control the committees.
Remember. Congressional elections are every 2 years and plan accordingly. Bob Good has already announced he's running.
Until then, we cannot wait until the 9th hour to chose our Republican nominee for State Senate to replace John McGuire. The election will take place over a matter of days, not weeks or months. So please be alert.
According to the Republican Party of Virginia attorney, the GOP will have 5 days to chose their nominee, with the election being held on January 7, 2025, the day prior to session.
We need a senator-elect, who can hit the ground running on day 1. I've served in the senate for 8 years from 2016-2023 and I'm ready to put my experience to work for the people of Virginia once again. You can trust my conservative lifetime voting record.
100% Family Foundation 100% VCDL A rating NRA
On July 2, I fully committed to running for the Virginia Senate.
The 10th Senatorial District is a very strong conservative Republican district. When I served the Virginia Senate from 2016 to 2023, my voting record was scored by many third party watchdog groups as one of the most conservative voting records in the Virginia Senate.
Many of you, live in the district, some of you do not. You can still give. You may or may not be able to vote for me, but I can still vote for you.
You know me. You know where I stand on the issues.
You saw me stand up against the 2021 gun grab, lead the charge against tyrannical covid mandates and confront politically correct politicians who refused to acknowledge that the 2020 presidential election was stolen.
Even when they put me in a plexiglass box because I refused to mask up and get the covid shot, I stood strong.
Despite the illegal censure by the Democrat controlled Senate of Virginia, I refused to compromise on boldly proclaiming the truth.

---
|
---
On Monday, please check your email for an important announcement.
We will be releasing a long awaited report that you won't want to miss.
---

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: it’s working!!!
body:
The media is starting to notice!
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

As you may have seen in the media, _Students for Life Action’s_ brand-new Digital Ad hitting Vice President Kamala Harris for her abortion extremism has been drawing some attention.

In fact, _Pro-Life Press,_ a pro-life news website, even had this to say about it:

_“The Abortion Lobby always outspends pro-lifers by millions of dollars. But Students for Life Action is trying to level the playing field with their new hard-hitting ad exposing Kamala Harris’ extreme position on abortion.”

“...Students for Life Action is the first and only national pro-life group to step up and hit Kamala Harris.”_
Needless to say, our ad is working, and in a big way!

If you haven’t yet seen it, you can see exactly why our ad is gaining so much traction by **[WATCHING IT HERE](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gilkdht-duchtdja-y/).**

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gilkdht-duchtdja-j/)
Now, I just need your support to ensure we can keep this ad running in Battleground States!

_**[If you could give $104.72, that would mean 5,200 views on Google ads on popular websites](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gilkdht-duchtdja-t/);**

**[If you could give $72.36, that would mean 200 ad views on YouTube](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gilkdht-duchtdja-i/);**

**[If you could give $54.23, that would mean 225 ad views on Facebook](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gilkdht-duchtdja-d/); and**

**[If you could give $13.44, that would mean 225 ad views on streaming services like Hulu and Roku](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gilkdht-duchtdja-h/).**_

Our ad has been kicking major butt so far, _especially reaching young voters,_ and will continue to do so as long as I can count on your full support!

Thank you for all you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

In a surprise move, Hunter Biden [pleaded guilty Thursday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFvgzAQRn-N2YzMYexk8NCFLV07ImMf4SrHjswFmn9f0bnbJ33De-_rNt08Jcr3T_9Ax0uZfGDacbpKI0FPuoluQQTsG3SdhcH06mqgWR0OsevAgkYb5wv0i4alt4OxOvYewtyQAwVaXZXplLIArRrmqIMFE4IK8WKFVhiJS22_C2VecUnvsmNtQ3k0ya3Mz030HwJGAeNxHG2Yt4zHdv4CxnMKGNdXZqxypohZ3l-U-C13rJECS_Y_Ene_UcmSK_kkYGyqi8-DUqLNnAr3h6f0h-R_-3cHvwEAAP__b5FeYw) to all nine charges in the federal tax case against him, with sentencing set for December 16.Biden initially [offered an Alford plea](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1ugzAUxfGnMZuRfWNMGDx0YUvXjsgfF7iRYyPjQPP2Vdq149FZfvp_3aabpUhp-bQPNHXOk_WVDpwGrjmoSTXBzIiAlwaN7KHTFzFoaFYz91Y4K6Xo0Hcu9BKdVtJe5eDUfFVDQwYEKDEILYXoAVrRuaB8D9p74cO1Z0pgoJpLe8-U6opzfOUDS-vzo4lmrXXb2eWDwchgPM-zTc4nPPf3z2DccqRKfmcw3jNyRwETg3F9porlb3JKFVPY-RbRBr48KdYXnzFgsZFX-839asuCOy8-WakHDbIpJmwnxUi7fhOXh6X4S6r_9jkM_AQAAP__X7Jprw), in which a defendant pleads guilty because the evidence against them is strong but maintains that they're innocent.When prosecutors refused to accept that plea, Biden made an open plea, admitting guilt and leaving the sentencing decision to the judge without a recommendation from prosecutors.According to a 56-page indictment, Biden stood accused of withholding at least $1.4 million in taxes over four years and filing false returns.

## Amtrak Gets $64M for Dallas-Houston Train
Amtrak has received a [$63.9 million federal grant](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskL2uozAQhZ8GukHGmL_CRRqKlbLlbokGZgzWGhvZTsjep79K6ludIx3p6NP39z7f0Trrt994sM4vE2Zcs33yPEIHUs2qJL0IGuuSdd3LtpNtMzTlrseWqG5JyMEoXEVDxnDf9r3Cjhs5iNJqKaQSo-hq0XZyqGpFQ98sjRiWdeXRFEow2RxilXfO_MJk3P_w5Fit4Sid3nM-U9HcCjkVcrquqzqSf2-FnNjDIxVy8ny949PxyBH_wcY5QacOsB4ME0d0YB6eEpgQYbfbDulkJohoHSycL2YPhM5hAvQEe3ikHPz7McLtVp9_vn6lMmo6L-ucTV1fKLEdaN0HNP-s7anldwAAAP__AKtxUw) to advance the Texas high-speed rail project, aiming to connect Dallas and Houston with a 90-minute journey. The 240-mile route, using [Japanese N700S Series Shinkansen](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskL1yhCAUhZ8Gu-vgFX8oKNLYbdqUDsJVyeLiANHdPH3GrdOc5sx858z3dRtv2nn3WD71Rio_5zBqk91Bo4QWUIyisGriVlYFqarDpsWm7utiVbPU81QZU_cVzihbK6WeRd9pyVHUPRVOIUfBJW8r3rTYl5WwfVdPNe8nY0jOTHCyLodY5pUyPXWa_SscFEsTtsKrNec9sfqD4cBwOM-zvE_5eZUMh4vNcODyiobhoLcc9R0SmZ9ICVoBm_PehQcsUT8yvAdgdcsKaSeyELXzsMfwTSbDHlJykyewtIcMU9S_IcGhvacXw6GIyu7nxUttxwRfNu38-2b-X9qh8C8AAP__hh9wFg) trains capable of speeds up to 205 MPH, faces challenges including land acquisition (only 30% secured) and estimated costs of up to $30 billion. | | This election is about more than just choosing a representative—it’s about choosing the direction of our future. **I’m Dr. Prasanth Reddy, and I’ve spent my life serving our country as a cancer doctor, a Lt. Colonel in the Air Force, and as someone who has experienced the American Dream firsthand.** I believe in a brighter future for Kansas and for America, one where our children and grandchildren can grow up in a nation that’s strong, prosperous, and free. **Our current path, under the leadership of Sharice Davids and her unwavering support for the Biden-Harris agenda, has led us astray.** _Their policies have brought us record inflation, open borders, and a ballooning national debt that threatens the future of our children._ But I believe we can change course. Together, we can restore the promise of America—a nation where hard work is rewarded, freedom is cherished, and our communities are safe and thriving. **As your congressman, I will fight for policies that lift up every Kansan. I will work to secure our borders, bring down the cost of living, and ensure that our government lives within its means, just as families across Kansas do every day.** My background in medicine and military service has taught me that with the right leadership, there’s no challenge too great for us to overcome. _Ronald Reagan once said, “America’s best days are yet to come.”_ I believe that with all my heart. **But those best days will only come if we stand up and fight for them.** This campaign isn’t just about me—it’s about all of us, working together to build a better future for Kansas and for our great nation. **I know many of you wonder, "Can we win?" Yes, we can.** But it won’t be easy, and we can’t rely on someone else to do the work for us. Sharice Davids is a tough opponent, but if we double our efforts and commit to doing more—knocking on more doors, making more calls, spreading our message farther—we will succeed. Together, we have the power to turn the tide. **But I can’t do it alone.** The road to victory is long, and it will take all of us working together to make this vision a reality. Whether you can donate a few dollars or volunteer a few hours of your time, your support is crucial. Every contribution, every hour of service, brings us one step closer to winning this fight and securing a brighter future for Kansas. I ask for your support, your prayers, and your vote as we work together to renew the promise of America. Let’s make sure that our best days truly are yet to come.

name: John Goodman
subject: I’m proud to support Lucas Kunce in his race against Josh Hawley
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70758?refcode=em20240906-7569&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7569%2E614464%2EWpjgKt)
Hey Peter, born-and-raised Missourian John Goodman here.
**The stakes are high this election year — especially in Missouri’s U.S. Senate race.** Here we’ve got Josh Hawley, the coward of January 6th, up against Lucas Kunce, a 13-year Marine veteran who knows what it’s like to grow up through hardship, fight for his community, and serve our country.
I’m proud to support Lucas, and in a moment I’ll ask you to join me. But first, I want to tell you why I know that Lucas can defeat Hawley this year and why his grassroots campaign urgently needs our help. **Please let me explain.**
**[CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70758?refcode=em20240906-7569&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7569%2E614464%2EWpjgKt)**
I’ll be honest: I’ve been ready to defeat Josh Hawley since January 6th, 2021.
He totally disgraced my home state that day... raising his fist because he wanted to look strong, and then running away like a little coward out the back door.
**But Josh Hawley has done a lot more than just that to embarrass Missouri over the years, stuff you probably wouldn’t even believe.**
Hawley himself played a major role in overturning Roe V. Wade — he even bragged about it! He backs the total abortion ban in Missouri, co-sponsored a national abortion ban, and is a pioneer of the legal movement threatening access to IVF and birth control nationwide.
Hawley forced Missouri taxpayers to cover his legal bills after he broke the law — $250,000, in this economy! He’s refused to invest a single dollar in Missouri, instead spending all his time writing stuff like his “Manhood” self-help book.
It’s just shameful.
**[CHIP IN TO BEAT HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70758?refcode=em20240906-7569&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7569%2E614464%2EWpjgKt)**
**Now let’s talk about Lucas Kunce.** I learned about Lucas probably the same way many of you did, from online ads and emails just like this one.
I heard Lucas’ story of struggle and community, which reminded me of my own. I’m sure it resonates with you too. Fellow American,

We don’t have much time left in the race for the Senate majority. And to be frank with you, I’m worried that our messages aren’t resonating with you or the voters we need to win over for victory in November. body:
Tammy Baldwin here — I wanted to make sure you saw this message from
Elissa Slotkin. Elissa is running in Michigan to defend our Democratic
majority, so I hope you'll read her message and [ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-slotkin.auoXDb&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240906_AM1_V1_S1&t=1003&akid=3576%2E35263%2EfwgEjL ]chip in if you can.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Peter, I want to
share a story about someone who, more than anyone, taught me the
importance of listening and accountability.

It’s Barack Obama.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-slotkin.auoXDb&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240906_AM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=3576%2E35263%2EfwgEjL ]Barack Obama and Elissa Slotkin

I was in the White House the first day he took office in 2009, serving as
a part of his national security staff. I staffed his meetings in the
Situation Room and briefed him in the Oval Office. Later, I was honored to
be nominated by him to serve in the Pentagon.

Despite his effortless charm in public, President Obama was a very tough
boss. I don’t think I’ve ever had a tougher boss than President Obama.
He’s brilliant, and he’s got a lawyer’s training where he’ll grill you
with difficult questions, one after another.

I learned pretty quickly to be prepared, because he was going to make sure
you knew your stuff.

What’s more, he was going to hold you accountable to what you said. If you
told him a fact or a plan, you’d better deliver on it. If you didn’t know
something, you should say that and not try to fudge your way through it.
That’s exactly the approach I try to take in Congress. I try my best to
know the details, make thoughtful decisions, and be transparent about what
I know and don’t know. Because I’ll never forget the lesson President
Obama taught me: you better say what you mean, and mean what you say.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-slotkin.auoXDb&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240906_AM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=3576%2E35263%2EfwgEjL ]That’s the kind of Senator I’ll be. And I’m building a grassroots
movement in that same spirit to bring accountability to the U.S. Senate.
With that in mind, will you chip in $10 to Tammy Baldwin and my campaign
to help us get there?

The Republican Party of Monroe County has been staying busy these past few weeks. From amazing parade floats at summer festivals to planting more than 200 yard sign, Monroe County Republicans are making their mark known. **Milwaukee County**
Milwaukee County Republicans showed up to table at their local "Mexican Fiesta." Two Milwaukee County Republicans got some screen time in their interview with the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation! **Brown County**
The Republican Party of Brown County welcomed future Vice President JD Vance to De Pere, Wisconsin. Wisconsinites were able to hear more about the Trump-Vance ticket's vision for the future of our country. **Calumet County**
We loved seeing our friends from the Calumet County Republican Party at their local fair. Members set up amazing booths and brightened the fair with their presence and patriotism! **Crawford County**
State Senator Marklein joined Crawford County Republicans at their local fair. Crawford County Republicans showed their support for the Dairy Farm Bureau at their booth. **Dodge County**
Members of the Dodge County went all out to decorate their cars for the Corn Carnival and Parade. **Door County**
The Republican Party of Door had a great turnout and an informative training on election integrity/Trump force 47 (learning how to engage voters in our communities)! Thanks to all who came. **Dunn County**
Members of the Republican Party of Dunn County gathered at the grand opening of the Options for Women Clinic in Menominee. We are so happy to see our supporters effecting great change in their communities! **Grant County**
Members of the Republican Party Grant County showed up at their County Fair to spread the Republican message and support their local candidates! **Jackson County**
The Republican Party of Jackson County joined their county's "Let's Walk" Campaign to raise money and awareness for public health. **Jefferson County**
The Republican Party of Jefferson County recently hosted two amazing events. First, they had their Trump Car and Truck Parade; (which was featured in the New York Post!) then, members met with Congressman Scott Fitzgerald. **La Crosse County**
La Crosse County hosted President Donald J. Trump and Congresswoman Tulsi Gabbard at a Town Hall. The event was a massive success, and we at the Republican Party of Wisconsin are honored to have Tulsi Gabbard's endorsement for Trump! **Langlade County**
Members of the Republican Party of Langlade County joined together to host a local Trump rally! **Outagamie County**
The Republican Party of Outagamie County hosted an incredible Corn Roast! We love seeing our members join together at fun events to celebrate one another and our great party! **Pierce County**
Members of the Republican Party of Pierce County gathered to watch the film "The Fall of Minneapolis" while writing post cards to GOTV for Congressman Derrick Van Orden. What a creative event! **Richland County**
The Richland County Republican Party had their grand opening for their new headquarters! They had more than 140 people come in to see their offices, obtain candidate signs merchandise, and to enjoy charcuterie boards, patriotic cupcakes and beverages. **Racine County**
Trump-Vance signs are officially a-go in the offices of the Racine County Republican Party! **Rock County**
The Republican Party of Rock County had a fantastic evening at their HQ for the 2024 Rock GOP Picnic. Thank you to everyone who came out and signed up to volunteer to ensure we get President Trump and all Republicans elected this November! **Sauk County**
Members of the Republican Party of Sauk County came together at their local fair! **St. Croix County**
Members of the Republican Party of St. Croix County were graciously invited by neighborly Minnesota Republicans to their Trump Boat Parade on the St. Croix River. It was a beautiful day! **Walworth County**
Another successful County Fair for the Republican Party of Walworth County **Waukesha County**
The Republican Party of Waukesha County joined India Fest, reaching out to the Indian Community about our shared values, signing up new members, selling Trump hats and t-shirts and distributing yard signs. **Wood County**
Members of the Wood County Republican Party listening in on Election Integrity Training. body:
Gov. Polis signs property tax deal into law as measures removed from ballot
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi folks,
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, September 6, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Gov. Polis signs property tax deal into law as measures removed from ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX 31 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
The governor on Wednesday officially signed into law the property tax agreement designed to keep two initiatives off this year’s Colorado ballot. Now that the deal is done, FOX31 is taking a closer look at the impact it could have on your wallet.
Property owners should still expect high property taxes this year, but state leaders say the increase will be lower than if the compromise had not been passed and if ballot initiatives 50 and 108 failed. If 50 and 108 passed without lawmakers reconvening for a special session, there could have been devastating impacts on funding for local services.
Lawmakers celebrated the end of what they called property tax wars with groups that often bring property tax measures, but some concerns around the effects still exist. The deal builds on the Senate bill designed to reduce property taxes that passed earlier this year.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Castle Rock exploring legal action over Denver’s ‘failed’ immigrant policy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Castle Rock's Town Council has unanimously voted to explore legal action against Denver over its immigration policies, which they argue have negatively impacted surrounding areas by attracting and inadequately managing a large influx of immigrants, primarily from Venezuela.
* Denver has spent approximately $74 million on temporary housing and food for immigrants, with local policies including paying for transportation to destination states.
* These policies are viewed by some neighboring jurisdictions as exacerbating the issue by attracting more immigrants to the area.
* Castle Rock is seeking to collaborate with Douglas County and other Front Range municipalities for a potential lawsuit against Denver, asserting that Denver's actions have spilled over into their communities without proper consultation or consideration of the broader impacts.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Friday hearing set for suspected gunman in Georgia high school shooting](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NEW YORK POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Four individuals, including two students and two teachers, were killed in a school shooting at Apalachee High School in northern Georgia, with nine others hospitalized due to injuries.
* The 14-year-old suspect, Colt Gray, a student from the same school, surrendered and was taken into custody; he will be charged with murder as an adult.
* Georgia Governor Brian Kemp has directed all available state resources to respond to the incident and urged prayers for safety across state classrooms.

* A court hearing for Colt Gray is scheduled for Friday, and the community held a vigil in Jug Tavern Park to mourn the victims and support each other during this tragedy.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Trump pleads not guilty to superseding indictment as Jan. 6 case back in DC court](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE HILL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former President Trump’s federal Jan. 6 case was back in a D.C. courtroom on Thursday.
* Trump was not there in person, but attorneys and prosecutors on special counsel Jack Smith’s team argued before U.S. District Judge Tanya Chutkan to determine how the case should proceed now that the Supreme Court ruled Trump has broad immunity from criminal prosecution.
* That high court decision in July sent Trump’s criminal prosecution back to the lower court to apply the standard. In Chutkan’s case, she sparked a flurry of activity in August when she announced she would hold a conference to chart the course of the case.
* Trump plead not guilty, through his team of lawyers.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Hunter Biden’s criminal tax trial begins with jury selection in California](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Jury selection for Hunter Biden's criminal tax trial has commenced in California, presided over by Judge Mark Scarsi, following charges laid by special counsel David Weiss concerning $1.4 million in overdue taxes which Hunter Biden has since paid but initially avoided.
* Hunter Biden faces three felonies and six misdemeanors from a purported four-year scheme starting in 2017 to evade federal income taxes and file false tax returns, leading to allegations of mismanaging his company's payroll to fund his lavish lifestyle instead of settling tax debts.
* This trial marks the second time this year that Hunter Biden has been tried under charges from Weiss's investigation, with previous convictions in Delaware for firearms charges pending sentencing, potentially amounting to 25 years in prison.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[In Arapahoe County, more Republicans needed as election judges among 800 being hired](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Arapahoe County, Colorado, is recruiting 700 to 800 temporary election judges to ensure a well-run election process for the upcoming November presidential election, with a particular need for more Republican judges.
* The positions, which pay and vary in duration, are crucial for maintaining election integrity, involving tasks such as processing ballots and assisting voters at polling centers.
* Longtime election judges emphasize the significance and personal satisfaction of the role, noting the bipartisan teamwork required and the opportunity it provides to affirm the security and efficiency of the electoral process.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Jury selected, opening statements set in King Soopers shooting trial](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BOULDER REPORTING LAB](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Jury selection for the trial of Ahmad Al Aliwi Alissa, the suspect in the King Soopers mass shooting in Boulder, has concluded with 16 jurors, including four alternates, chosen from an initial pool of 1,500.
* The trial, overseen by Judge Ingrid Bakke, began on August 26, 2024, with opening statements scheduled for September 5, to be livestreamed for public viewing.
* Witness testimony will involve Alissa's family members and police officers, with bodycam footage from the shooting expected to be presented. The focus of the trial will be on Alissa's mental health and the question of his legal sanity at the time of the incident, where he was the confirmed sole gunman responsible for 10 deaths.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Caldara: Learning to live without a functional Colorado GOP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_I’m trying to come up with the right analogy. I’m sure you can do much better._
_I’m thinking of a bunch of little kids playing king of the hill. In their minds, they think the pile of dirt is Mount Everest, when, in fact, it’s the size of a pitching mound._
_Or maybe one of those Japanese soldiers who was left on a small, isolated island for decades not knowing World War II had ended and his side lost. He’s still fighting._
_Or, perhaps, corporate shareholders fighting for control of a company they think is the size of IBM when in fact it’s a broken hot dog cart._

subject: I won’t back down
body:
Help me speak louder
| Peter, I’m Riley Gaines. Maybe you’ve heard me talk about how other female swimmers and I were forced to compete against men -- and even share locker rooms with them.
Most people sat idly by and allowed this injustice to happen. That’s when I realized that nobody else was going to stand up for me, my teammates, and other women like us. I had to speak out. That’s why I launched the **Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute.** My team of Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are building a movement of students, athletes, and concerned citizens who are fed up with the attack on our freedoms and rights. I’d love to have you join us to defy the dangerous gender ideology that’s spreading rampant throughout society today. [Together, you and I will fight against insanity like this: ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=326ddb6088584bbdb3d01cb178ba30e1&_e=77MzdNBqA20jVKYi4CBlL4r0Iri_nnoEbTRDNHmSZ7E68hwT1vesjHGOt54QvkXA9I77X5o_aUw6IeSp_Tm0x0vgmWmRpaWxsjJwpfgy2w2FsrwK_r_-vWuk8JEBQqfoAnjyAT8DTWON1i06c5CQFxUChroZHTNSov8G6ZOeFcEKwVtyw77NvjfN1aQv9-oplb0KMENIi8uzeNbL4vV0HYXAgQUmmXMr1YqAA1CKGmUo3QqBolb9l7y7Jwl5X4NfIg8JGs5Q4IwV4hG6lvUQj7YTPEsYAxxf-j2YyysZYyRaBDna2pFVVR1TpsPsYWQYAhtJylDbPhon-ou95JFw87dHupZNjWzUbZRQDmQOjjQnm6pVjkm5c1UKOBUZmNWviHbdDzTXVCxi68ssskhMgQFvUEWIy1nGoicT6e8GVClvqMIhbRPgK1-W8Q-mfRHYDLkftekiJopoEzC157QIIATT7XYL8yVrTufJcf0cBI4Ke14yNiVM4rhvEKoSlZLUkfm5vwKRtx-KiXP-PZfigw%3D%3D) [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=326ddb6088584bbdb3d01cb178ba30e1&_e=77MzdNBqA20jVKYi4CBlL4r0Iri_nnoEbTRDNHmSZ7E68hwT1vesjHGOt54QvkXA9I77X5o_aUw6IeSp_Tm0x0vgmWmRpaWxsjJwpfgy2w2FsrwK_r_-vWuk8JEBQqfoAnjyAT8DTWON1i06c5CQFxUChroZHTNSov8G6ZOeFcEKwVtyw77NvjfN1aQv9-oplb0KMENIi8uzeNbL4vV0HYXAgQUmmXMr1YqAA1CKGmUo3QqBolb9l7y7Jwl5X4NfIg8JGs5Q4IwV4hG6lvUQj7YTPEsYAxxf-j2YyysZYyRaBDna2pFVVR1TpsPsYWQYAhtJylDbPhon-ou95JFw87dHupZNjWzUbZRQDmQOjjQnm6pVjkm5c1UKOBUZmNWv8JSByE1VSBowAMqfUZztQlE-wtvMNYXRpPrI8mlRlTmK4F5f64LaJ3MnKBfHH1xlptbnW9fY4LXL4v18uplzwXTk1VGnXVBWi0D5PxwarCEs07TaDCw_4mkiWqtWg2M_G9pwjrzrKlChr8XuK4rkRg%3D%3D) Women already fought for equality. _Now, our achievements are being erased by men who declare themselves women._ Government is making matters worse. Look how the Biden Administration is altering Title IX rules, for instance. Title IX used to protect against discrimination on the basis of sex -- on the incontrovertible, biological fact that men are men and women are women and both are afforded equal access under the law to government-funded programs. But now, the Biden administration’s proposed Title IX changes will stop schools from enforcing women-only recognitions and spaces. They’ll rob women of opportunities, put them in physical danger, and silence them when they dare to dissent. %%first%%, I’ve gotten used to the left trying to shut me up. **But now they’re trying to erase all women**. I’m not backing down from this fight. I hope you won’t either. On behalf of America’s daughters, [ I hope you will stand with me by donating $500, $250, $100, $50, or even $25 right now!](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=326ddb6088584bbdb3d01cb178ba30e1&_e=77MzdNBqA20jVKYi4CBlL4r0Iri_nnoEbTRDNHmSZ7E68hwT1vesjHGOt54QvkXA9I77X5o_aUw6IeSp_Tm0x0vgmWmRpaWxsjJwpfgy2w2FsrwK_r_-vWuk8JEBQqfoAnjyAT8DTWON1i06c5CQFxUChroZHTNSov8G6ZOeFcEKwVtyw77NvjfN1aQv9-oplb0KMENIi8uzeNbL4vV0HYXAgQUmmXMr1YqAA1CKGmUo3QqBolb9l7y7Jwl5X4NfIg8JGs5Q4IwV4hG6lvUQj7YTPEsYAxxf-j2YyysZYyRaBDna2pFVVR1TpsPsYWQYAhtJylDbPhon-ou95JFw87dHupZNjWzUbZRQDmQOjjQnm6pVjkm5c1UKOBUZmNWvJl6JGxFqbJstvJR8QUla-W7uUVpJWaDm5do-_oZ-QOunJlMGrg_tnTNBE0TOWU7Qj8xqtxjwYm3REc5P0lKrmK04yoEolMHUElXi_9mfkiq1Xs4hGNWuPV8nsC8PyeJcmKN8_-JzJBEWFNTbv5MUEQ%3D%3D) At this urgent moment, my Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are working to protect the rights of women and girls against the Biden administration’s Title IX changes. clean_body: Help me speak louder | Peter, I’m Riley Gaines. Maybe you’ve heard me talk about how other female swimmers and I were forced to compete against men -- and even share locker rooms with them. Most people sat idly by and allowed this injustice to happen. That’s when I realized that nobody else was going to stand up for me, my teammates, and other women like us. I had to speak out. That’s why I launched the Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute. My team of Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are building a movement of students, athletes, and concerned citizens who are fed up with the attack on our freedoms and rights. I’d love to have you join us to defy the dangerous gender ideology that’s spreading rampant throughout society today. Women already fought for equality. Now, our achievements are being erased by men who declare themselves women. Government is making matters worse. Look how the Biden Administration is altering Title IX rules, for instance. Title IX used to protect against discrimination on the basis of sex -- on the incontrovertible, biological fact that men are men and women are women and both are afforded equal access under the law to government-funded programs. But now, the Biden administration’s proposed Title IX changes will stop schools from enforcing women-only recognitions and spaces. They’ll rob women of opportunities, put them in physical danger, and silence them when they dare to dissent. %%first%%, I’ve gotten used to the left trying to shut me up. But now they’re trying to erase all women. I’m not backing down from this fight. I hope you won’t either. On behalf of America’s daughters, At this urgent moment, my Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are working to protect the rights of women and girls against the Biden administration’s Title IX changes. We’re taking on the gender ideology radicals who aim to erase women’s place in this country. Patriotic Americans like you who care about women’s rights -- and the truth -- are rising up to stand with us. Together, you and I can stop the left’s attacks, and save women’s place in America’s future. | Hello Fellow Patriot,

Our nation is at a crossroads, facing immense challenges that threaten our values and the future we hope to build. Conservative principles like faith, liberty, community, and life are under constant attack. It's in times like these that we look to leaders who embody these values. But today, Dr. Carson finds himself needing your support in a deeply personal way.

**As Dr. Carson's 73rd birthday approaches, we want to fill his desk with birthday wishes from patriots like you. Will you take a moment to[sign his birthday card](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=eab070229be94c47bc244691b0a64952&_e=7ittbHsd5d3xfRm9UD-ZP8s8bGqVPUZgEy85ezBgj5TbziJH_jQfyh-3kzSlJzGeVPb5vFRMENyJDUfv3RoA-6BoLiLVDjtefXIFMPXfbU0NZJntYr0jCZB8kPDlnK0Cbb9dZhhrC9P134Xh83hrCHvpVt-NQOISvrGx6NLWV0WtSq7UFPDr0ZrCW-PvqXhxNS_4PCiJ0IqX_ZGAsBUJTJ3DS38wh0ghHXuPlfkiAa27M-cPDSNDPH2DL_N3YWvj9zN1Rk98VbavT5x5sh7K-eRMU3C6scMRLZfIQxC3RRX2a2SDeYKB7AAranbVXyJGMDwmyEaJo3534rFBeV13mJcdEG4CcTMoKl_XtvF5mdGeJQPFr-ywW89aHyYnRRJnGv-PkHccCPPnMNjIx2uLletp_qYWtQSm9YdiR2sG8Ag%3D) and add a personal note?**

Thousands of individuals who cherish the same values have already signed the card, showing that Dr. Carson is not alone in this fight. But it will take a groundswell of support to make our collective voices heard and to show that we stand united behind leaders like Dr. Carson.

By adding your name to this card, you're not just wishing Dr. Carson a happy birthday - you're also affirming the values and principles that guide us. Together, we can make a difference and reinforce the conservative cause.

[**Click here to add your name today!**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=eab070229be94c47bc244691b0a64952&_e=7ittbHsd5d3xfRm9UD-ZP8s8bGqVPUZgEy85ezBgj5TbziJH_jQfyh-3kzSlJzGeVPb5vFRMENyJDUfv3RoA-6BoLiLVDjtefXIFMPXfbU0NZJntYr0jCZB8kPDlnK0Cbb9dZhhrC9P134Xh83hrCHvpVt-NQOISvrGx6NLWV0WtSq7UFPDr0ZrCW-PvqXhxNS_4PCiJ0IqX_ZGAsBUJTJ3DS38wh0ghHXuPlfkiAa27M-cPDSNDPH2DL_N3YWvjLDRyIORVTdlUfcB1_svb28-ZVCZsqEWkv-ySbJzDHS13pYiBuwM9S2Yykz2nhPHkwCMPRQNAae1a2cqoCSxwUpSCelUh-Q6s8KPsoNB_H-Eqek_sc7VQw0GVQltItc4a5PZd16O50cBWoZ5clTULlDa6CDfpE7BWDGLWGAt6r2E%3D)

After signing, you'll have the opportunity to further support the American Cornerstone Institute and the principles Dr. Carson represents. Your help is crucial in restoring faith, bringing patriotic education back to our schools, and healing the divisiveness that holds us back from real progress.

Thank you for your support, and may God bless you.

The American Cornerstone Institute

name: Senator Lashrecse Aird
subject: FAREWELL SUMMER, WELCOME FALL!
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Friends of Lashrecse Aird
body:
As summer days enter our rearview mirror and we look forward to fall, I wish all our educators and students an amazing new school year. I salute workers, labor unions, and working family allies as we continue to observe Labor Day and reflect on how we are each the beneficiaries of workers!

Before we completely move on from the remaining summer days, this month’s extended update will highlight the work we’ve continued to do on your behalf legislatively through the Interim Boards and Commissions I’ve been assigned to serve on and generally the numerous community meetings we’ve organized or attended.

BOARDS AND COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS

During each legislative session in re-organizing years (after each election year) every Senator is appointed to serve on legislative committees that meet primarily during the General Assembly session to hear proposed legislation. However, when the General Assembly session adjourns, members continue their legislative work, through Interim Boards and Commissions. [https://studies.virginiageneralassembly.gov/]

Virginia has over 200 legislative Interim Boards and Commissions and they’ve developed through authorizing legislation, often for a fixed period to solve complex legislative challenges or have a study conducted. There are also national organizations structured through multi-state cooperative agreements to help policymakers make informed decisions by providing independent, accurate data and recommendations.

This term I have been appointed to serve on the following legislative commissions:
*
Virginia

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Sept/Screenshot%202024-09-05%20at%202.40.36%E2%80%AFPM.png]
The Tobacco Commission [https://revitalizeva.org/] is a 28-member body focused on economic growth in formerly tobacco-dependent communities by providing grant funding and other strategic investments. This is my second stint serving on the commission, having previously served as the Vice Chair while a member of the House of Delegates, I am excited to represent our region again and support this critical mission. Our spring meeting [https://revitalizeva.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/Virginia-Tobacco-Commission-Meeting-Packet-May-21-22-2024-1.pdf] took place in Wise County, where we toured the DeBusk Veterinary Education and Training Center in Ewing to learn about the workforce development initiatives underway. Sussex and Dinwiddie County, both in our district, are within the Commission’s footprint and eligible for resources.
Southern Regional Education Board Legislative Work Conference
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Sept/Screenshot%202024-09-05%20at%202.42.24%E2%80%AFPM.png]
The Southern Regional Education Board’s (SREB) Legislative Work Conference occurred in Dallas. The SREB is a 16-state nonpartisan, nonprofit interstate compact that helps states focus on education policy within the compact, creating a dialogue around best practices and innovations that can improve educational outcomes throughout the region. At my first meeting, I learned about best practices for tracking educational outcomes, incentivizing new teacher hiring and retention, and AI tools being widely adopted by educators and school leaders.

Fellow Patriot, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Fellow Patriot, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c772c71f06eb41f7a8684b6c190e81c3&_e=TboVi5C7uY4okUqELdgXZikmu-wCtcDCphQlBDX1lJgMglOeG9SqCMWnad35ljOouVE4kJc7SQm7NFOGW0Lq9kdMstJJPa3R-bSWIcORSApqFrkYvXYd3_3BzUuK77ICNMg234Xg-jeZgfvovY0dzJu0OKoBmpRRcpDXmUwb-la8W5EJIP_C1uV6eEoqJwYFllzFDUAmqoKbIGja85Up_BLIQLo3Fd8dln66tn_5f1onrUVI318I0QsPP-R6rlsONg46OHiE4WQAPBpP-SCEF-H6tnmTJcUnZKrO8KJxwPMF3GnZhffUryaAhI6S5wgE)_

Fellow Patriot, I'm proud to say that _Right Wing Revolution_ is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before:
* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

Early in-person voting map, courtesy of Axios [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/Axios_MailInVotingMap.png]

Turnout is going to be key , and we're going to make sure we can get every pro-democracy voter to the ballot that we can, armed with the information they need to show up and vote. We're going to make sure every single mail-in ballot is lawfully cast and counted . We’re contacting voters ahead of every key registration, ballot request, and early voting deadline... and those deadlines are coming up fast .
This election will determine whether our democracy goes back to the darkness and conspiracy theories of the recent past or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and march forward to a better future.

It’s absolutely disgusting
#

Yesterday at a rally in Arizona, vice presidential candidate JD Vance called school shootings a “fact of life.”
JD Vance wrote off school shootings as inevitable in our society less than 48 hours after two students and two teachers were shot dead at school.
**It’s absolutely disgusting.**
We have a clear choice on the ballot this November: We can elect Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz, who are both proven gun safety champions. Or we can allow four years of inaction if Donald Trump and JD Vance take back the White House.
[**We’re doing everything we can to elect Vice President Harris and Governor Walz at GIFFORDS PAC. Will you make a contribution today to help fuel these critical efforts?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240906-1-30&t=1&akid=8877%2E3935704%2ErSI1EC)

We’re not surprised that JD Vance was Donald Trump’s choice for running mate. Both of them have the same attitude when it comes to gun violence in America. After the devastating school shooting at Perry High School in Iowa earlier this year, Trump told a crowd at an Iowa rally they “have to get over it.”
He also bragged at an NRA event that his administration “did nothing” on guns. This is true. We already knew Donald Trump doesn’t care about saving lives from gun violence, now it’s clear JD Vance doesn’t either.
JD Vance has got it all wrong. School shootings are not a “fact of life.” And turning our schools into prisons isn’t the answer either. There are commonsense gun safety solutions that can prevent tragedies by keeping guns out of the hands of people who want to do harm. Universal background checks, extreme risk protection orders, and safe storage laws are all effective tools that can save lives.
[**Vice President Harris and Governor Tim Walz are the only candidates we can trust to put our safety of gun lobby profits. name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Trump + Lake vs. You + Me
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
|
I don’t want to give it too much attention, Derek, but Trump spoke in Arizona twice last month, including one time with my opponent, Kari Lake, at a rally in Phoenix.
He laid out his cynical and divisive worldview for the millionth time. He spoke about his extreme, radical, dangerous agenda. And he put us — our campaign — square in the middle of his warpath. He attacked me multiple times, and said I "shouldn't even be allowed to run."
But most importantly, he said if he wins in Arizona he wins the presidency. He said it himself: He has to go straight through us to have any chance at winning this November.
But I’ve got a message for him: **Show some respect.**
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em_gallego.qc2Spo&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240906_AM1_V1_S1&t=3&akid=7384%2E5257348%2EChFHkh)
After years of attacking and insulting veterans like John McCain, or Gold Star Parents like the Khans, the fallen of Belleau Wood, even Medal of Honor recipients — show some respect for the military, for veterans, and for our families.
**We’ve got your number, Donald. And we will not let you win.**
This election is going to come down to Trump and Lake versus you and me, Derek. Can I count on you to have my back as I take the fight to them from now until November?
**[If you’re still with me, please, make a split $10 donation with Adam Schiff and support our work in Arizona. This will be one of the closest states in the country, and we need everyone on board and doing everything we can to win here.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em_gallego.qc2Spo&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240906_AM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=4&akid=7384%2E5257348%2EChFHkh)**

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Our race is tightening
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
|
---
Friends - I want you to see one of the most recent polls in our race: **Michigan Senate - AARP Poll**
Slotkin (D): 47%
Rogers (R): 44% This poll shows our lead shrinking a bit compared to a pair of recent polls that had us +6, and +4. Being on the wrong side of a momentum swing just before early voting starts is the last thing any campaign wants. It's potentially devastating. Not only is it bad news in its own right, but it can also attract a flood of Republican spending if they smell opportunity. #
Dear Friend,

Every 80 seconds, a preborn child loses its life at the hands of Planned Parenthood. This means that by the time you finish reading this email, another innocent life will be gone.

Despite the Supreme Court ruling in the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ , Planned Parenthood continues to receive taxpayer funding, effectively subsidizing the intentional killing of preborn children. Since 2000, nearly $10.7 billion of taxpayers' money has funded their life-ending work.

Contrast this with the nearly 3,000 Pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide dedicated to supporting expectant mothers. Planned Parenthood only operates about 600 facilities and primarily offers one service: abortion. Alarmingly, they perform 62 abortions for every prenatal care service they provide, and prenatal care services are down 80% since 2010.

As a pro-life individual, I know you don't want your hard-earned tax dollars to support an organization that prioritizes abortion.

That's why I'm urging you to join us to demand an end to this taxpayer-funded ongoing tragedy. A new Congress and president will be chosen this November, and they need to hear from us _now_ that America does NOT support funding Planned Parenthood.

Make your voice heard. Sign our petition before midnight to demand an end to this grave misuse of your taxes. **[https://www.liveaction.org/defund-planned-parenthood-petition/](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=3499da5a99e748178874d2b8eb105426&_e=G4turNkIxoEJxkviiQ3G-j5NZ25-ebliBQ-NpI64oupkI_73qFydkm-EGKXoGNQ5bpt-OQjCLSk6hN4jv9phtuYEzbx2V1nmb9uhiEGCYYj_dNe20iVuViPeKhagEtmxwLt7AmCfvswRulSNzretpGldbyRZ-gGALaNODz7lGHYYva39zWKkP0dKW3qIH5kvQjR2zllslc0QZICMZ7WuAE3_IHu7okE4rybKM4Wt0OL8yPzZktJrH6uG_35GeZYz2aBPzupkWAoiRQe1GoMSZk6ifgipi8cQimD27OSY9HmHlNzjuEYTOBW-FUlvU7Qjt0W4f95rc3gDcN03MaPtVXqgmYzdrob0gw4D_cy0lyx-20ZFETJntFW137XWVnZuI8YUiE-wwFL8py7LeCAAcQ%3D%3D)**

Thank you for standing with us for the protection of future generations!

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

Kash Kelly, Tamiko Holt, Tom McDonald
By Illinois Review

The summit is hosted by The Freedom’s Journal Institute (FJI) – an Illinois-based nonprofit organization designed to “advance the Kingdom of God through socio-political, education and engagement.” The 3-day conference, which begins on Friday and ends on Sunday, includes breakout sessions throughout the day and keynote speakers in the evening. On Saturday evening, U.S. Sen. Tim Scott (R-NC) will headline the dinner program after a private VIP meet-and-greet, which will include special guest and Chicago Cubs co-owner Todd Ricketts.

The event, which takes place at Insight Church in Tinley Park, is expected to draw hundreds of attendees from across the country. The agenda, which includes the tagline, “Black America at a Crossroads: Cultural Marxism vs. A Biblical Worldview,” is timely, just months before a historic presidential election in November.

name: Lucas Tyree Kunce
subject: I need you to know what I’m fighting for in this race.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
#
Peter,
I’m running for U.S. Senate because I want everyday Missourians to call the shots in our country — not giant corporations or the cowards like Josh Hawley they’ve bought off in Washington. **This email is long, but I hope you’ll take some time to read it:**
**[CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70786?refcode=em20240906-7570&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7570%2E614464%2EZg7oEf)**
**When I came home between deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan, it was clear to me that Missouri is on the frontlines of the fight for power in our country.**
While communities like mine all across our state were stripped for parts, corrupt politicians like Josh Hawley attacked workers with anti-union schemes like “Right-to-Work” and fought to block wage increases for Missouri families — all to enrich multinational corporations and mega-donors who bankroll their campaigns and their careers.
They helped Wall Street financiers sell off our farmland to billionaires in China and Brazil — devastating rural communities and contributing to the closure of 90% of Missouri hog producers in a single generation.
One of Missouri’s oldest and largest employers, Anheuser-Busch, was sold to a Belgian conglomerate — costing Missouri more than a thousand jobs.
Missouri-based Monsanto, one of the world’s most important agrochemical and biotechnology companies, was sold to Germany — eliminating even more jobs.
And as dozens more headquarters were taken out of state, politicians in power like Josh Hawley were happy to sit back and watch it happen.
**Manufacturing, agriculture, production — they’re shipping it all away to foreign oligarchs who don’t care about working people in our state.** And while our communities were being gutted, these same politicians voted time and time again to spend trillions of dollars and thousands of lives on overseas wars that got their Big Oil friends rich.
These politicians have spent decades sparking phony culture wars to distract and divide our families. They’ve become so obsessed with controlling our lives, they made Missouri the first state in the nation to ban abortion.
**Our state deserves a Senator who will stand up and fight for it — and I’m ready to serve.[So if you’re ready to elect a real warrior for working people to Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, will you please rush a donation of any amount so we can get our election-winning message in front of Missouri voters?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70786?refcode=em20240906-7570&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7570%2E614464%2EZg7oEf)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70787?refcode=em20240906-7570&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=3&akid=7570%2E614464%2EZg7oEf) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70787?refcode=em20240906-7570&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=4&akid=7570%2E614464%2EZg7oEf) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70786?refcode=em20240906-7570&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7570%2E614464%2EZg7oEf)
---
We aren’t fighting the corporate status quo just to make a point, either. **This is a race we really can win.**
Our values have won at the ballot box in Missouri for referendums that go beyond what’s happening nowadays in Washington, or even what political elites in Jefferson City are willing to allow.
For the last three election cycles, Missouri voters have side-stepped our politicians by voting to increase the minimum wage well above the federal level, expand health care, repeal an anti-worker “Right-to-Work” scheme, legalize weed, and enact more protections against political corruption with wide margins.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70786?refcode=em20240906-7570&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=7570%2E614464%2EZg7oEf)
**So now, we’re building a record-breaking, people-powered movement to defeat Josh Hawley and take this Senate seat back for working Missourians.**
Together, we’re going to stop printing money for Wall Street and start funding our schools enough to get Missouri out of last place for starting teacher pay.
We’re going to abolish corporate PACs and demand a government that safeguards our democracy and holds corrupt politicians accountable.
We’re going to take back Missouri farmland for Missouri farmers and start manufacturing essential drugs right here in America.
We’re going to build an economy that puts American workers and small businesses in charge, not giant corporations and foreign oligarchs — an economy that invests in putting America first in the next generation of energy, semiconductors, and supply chain independence.
We’re going to put an end to pointless, trillion-dollar wars and invest in a Marshall Plan for the Midwest — a historic investment in our workers and communities to rebuild our forgotten towns and cities, and to finally start making stuff in America again.
And we’re going to finally put everyday Missourians in charge of their own neighborhoods, workplaces, and bodies.
**It’s time to take our power back — and we can’t do it without your support.[So please, will you rush a donation of absolutely any amount toward our September fundraising goal today? I’m not taking a cent from corporate PACs in this race, so you’ll always know I’m fighting for everyday, working people in the U.S. Senate.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70786?refcode=em20240906-7570&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=7570%2E614464%2EZg7oEf)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70787?refcode=em20240906-7570&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=8&akid=7570%2E614464%2EZg7oEf) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70787?refcode=em20240906-7570&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=9&akid=7570%2E614464%2EZg7oEf) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70787?refcode=em20240906-7570&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=10&akid=7570%2E614464%2EZg7oEf) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70787?refcode=em20240906-7570&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=11&akid=7570%2E614464%2EZg7oEf) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70787?refcode=em20240906-7570&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=12&akid=7570%2E614464%2EZg7oEf) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70787?refcode=em20240906-7570&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=13&akid=7570%2E614464%2EZg7oEf) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/70786?refcode=em20240906-7570&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=14&akid=7570%2E614464%2EZg7oEf)
---
Thank you for everything, Peter.
Now let’s get moving,
Lucas

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lk-email-footer?refcode=em20240906-7570-footer&t=15&refcode2=7570_614464_Zg7oEf&akid=7570%2E614464%2EZg7oEf)**

Hello,
Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad.
For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before _Roe v. Wade_ ...
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92286347/496610277/1610638071?refcode=em20240906mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=1f381610-696c-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjM4MTYxMC02OTZjLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=77M9gt04yBngREWDbWz2-ihyLAmhpsFJgrzQJVZjbCU=)
Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats.
Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue.
My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy.
**Extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not.**
What’s extreme is pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages.
Their views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor.
I would have thought that after almost losing this seat last year, they might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But they've only doubled down on the extreme.
**Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024 by winning this seat in Congress.**

And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy. Extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not. What’s extreme is pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages. Their views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor. I would have thought that after almost losing this seat last year, they might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But they've only doubled down on the extreme. Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024 by winning this seat in Congress. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Thank you for letting me share some of my story with you. * * *
##### Florida whistleblower news
Thank you for helping fellow [geographer-turned-whistleblower James Gaddis](https://substack.com/redirect/115035a6-6476-4268-b3cb-0ee86cca9e58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after he was fired for leaking documents that ultimately foiled Ron DeSantis' plans to turn state parks into mega-resorts and golf courses. DeSantis' Russian-backed cyber mob quickly swarmed to attack and defame Gaddis, and the state attempted to retaliate against him by leaking documents showed he had resigned from a previous position (which is neither relevant to his whistleblowing nor an indication of wrongdoing). The people of Florida -- as they have done in the past -- are not putting up with it and are rightfully siding with Gaddis.
Speaking of Florida whistleblowers and geographers -- I head to Florida for depositions in less than two weeks, and still need help fundraising for expenses incurred during the lawsuit. If every one of my followers donated $0.10, we'd have enough money to pay for all the experts and depositions we need in my lawsuit against the state of Florida. For all those the algorithm won't show this to, [please donate a $1 or more to our legal fund](https://substack.com/redirect/2f37f6d3-b7d0-426c-b365-5662c0335015?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[Click here to donate](https://substack.com/redirect/2f37f6d3-b7d0-426c-b365-5662c0335015?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
##### Florida breaks campaign laws in using state resources for political advocacy
In flagrant violation of Florida law ([FS 104.31](https://substack.com/redirect/a0899d8f-b802-4e4d-9135-3afe18a683d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)), the Florida Agency for Healthcare Administration has added disinformation about Florida's ballot measure on abortion, written by registered foreign agent and DeSantis "online media manager" Christina Pushaw.
Pushaw has been connected with other Russian assets named in the DOJ criminal indictment [filed earlier this week](https://substack.com/redirect/c71d5263-99c8-40f7-9c8b-22038494944e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). She was also [arrested for violating a restraining order I had against her ](https://substack.com/redirect/7053ab1d-a35d-4a64-8b76-4b49e2e49cc3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)before she was hired by DeSantis -- something[ she wrote about ](https://substack.com/redirect/310b6020-ebf6-4990-82ea-51861f78a2bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)in her cover letter for the job. More on that below.
* * *
## FEATURE: DOJ moves to charge Russian assets in American culture -- including some of my biggest online harassers.
For years, those who have been targeted by highly-organized defamation and harassment campaigns online have been raising alarms about the sophistication and strategies used to attack them -- methods that mirror tactics developed and deployed mostly by Russia.
Disinformation experts like [Jim Stewartson](https://open.substack.com/users/54369542-jim-stewartson?utm_source=mentions) provided evidence and even produced documentaries about the topic, imploring the government to act and warning those who were targeted.
While Stewartson's platform is quite large, the attacks directed at him caused public figures at times to distance themselves from him and his "Russian obsession."
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubWVzb3NjYWxlbmV3cy5jb20vYWNjb3VudCIsInAiOjE0ODU3NzkzOCwicyI6MjgzNDQ5LCJmIjpmYWxzZSwidSI6OTA1MDExOTIsImlhdCI6MTcyNTYzOTAxOCwiZXhwIjoxNzI4MjMxMDE4LCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMCIsInN1YiI6ImxpbmstcmVkaXJlY3QifQ.lh_gXpcl-aFTriQwyB-Q3IfeuKYd08Q3-Gbua49R2vg?)
Stewartson was proven right (again) in a [criminal indictment ](https://substack.com/redirect/c71d5263-99c8-40f7-9c8b-22038494944e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)filed by the Department of Justice earlier this week.
The indictment identified several conservative "influencers" as being recipients of as much as $400,000 per month to peddle Russian messaging and engage in disinformation campaigns.
I was the target of one of those campaigns.
Stewartson entered my story in the spring of 2021 -- about the time the harassment campaign against me started up with Christina Pushaw, who was unemployed and living in Washington, DC at the time.
Pushaw refused to identify the source of her funding when questioned in court, and falsely claimed she was writing a "follow up article" about me as the justification for her criminal harassment and stalking -- an article that never materialized. Pushaw of course lied about the[ restraining order ](https://substack.com/redirect/21783524-3e15-4bbb-b491-35554f39a011?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)I had against her, and then[ lied again](https://substack.com/redirect/2d757337-5184-4299-a2b7-d846022fcd50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about being[ charged for violating it](https://substack.com/redirect/d7534e5d-7cca-449a-8220-7836b3e8d3fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Stewartson contacted me because he noticed a large amount of inauthentic accounts suddenly appearing online with the sole purpose of trying to discredit me and my whistleblower claim (this all started about one month after DeSantis ordered an armed raid on my home). At first (admittedly) I brushed him off.
Even though[ just weeks prior](https://substack.com/redirect/11362ece-15c8-4a6f-9e53-d7ac31370ead?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) I had told Russian state media to get lost in rather course terms (they asked for an interview and my only response was "How's Navalny?"), I didn't think I was that much of a disruption to the status-quo.
While I knew Russia engineered QAnon and other conspiracy theories, I didn't think I was high enough up on the list for Russia to invest any meaningful resources toward defaming me.
I guess I underestimated my impact.
The Department of Justice unveiled multiple cases [involving foreign influence campaigns](https://substack.com/redirect/c71d5263-99c8-40f7-9c8b-22038494944e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) within American media and the [Trump administration ](https://substack.com/redirect/d5214c11-d987-4553-9fa0-56aec393808a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)this week, unveiling the start of a massive operation to suss out foreign influence in American politics.
Among them is Tim Pool, who[ posted this video ](https://substack.com/redirect/aecec19d-ba0a-4a99-84a8-45a928564431?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)accusing me of "lying for political gain."
Tim Pool isn't anywhere near the largest conservative influencer out there - he's C-list at best.
But that doesn't make his crimes or the harm he's caused to others -- all to get rich with foreign money -- any less devastating for his victims.
And the people he's most connected to in the harassment campaign scene are the same people who created and spread false, defamatory and vile lies about me, my family and what happened in Florida during COVID-19.
##### It's not just fringe YouTubers
Not only are "influencers" with YouTube channels and Twitter accounts among the known paid assets, but the indictment states a number of journalists are on Russia's payroll, as well.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/141c9664-7c1e-41e3-bbfa-267ae28b69ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Four-times-fired reporter Marc Caputo (previously with the Miami Herald, Politico, NBC, and The Messenger) fabricated a story in April 2022 about an investigation into my whistleblower complaint initiated by the state. My advocates went to NBC, who were reportedly shocked and confused by the highly personal attacks Caputo levied against me online, and the editorializing he did in articles that he was trying to pass off as hard news. He was fired later that year.
Caputo is known for turning perceived slights into "[blood feuds](https://substack.com/redirect/3212944b-a3a1-4a35-8c12-9c45fc8c3fc7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." When I called out Marc Caputo for making sexist remarks in questioning whether or not I was a "real scientist" just days after the raid on my home, I hit a nerve. He
Caputo was embroiled in controversy long before I came into the picture. In 2016, he published hacked DNCC documents he [received from a Russian operative](https://substack.com/redirect/bcf5d273-fa76-45a2-b5da-6dc99552eb1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- even though he knew the Russians had illegally obtained it. Caputo was at Politico at the time, a publication that received allegedly-hacked insider details of the Trump campaign last month and [decided NOT to publish them](https://substack.com/redirect/1016195e-9282-452a-9ddf-4f61366a764a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
I would reckon that reporters who have been found to participate in "pay-to-play" news writing in the past might also make an appearance -- including the websites "[The Capitolist](https://substack.com/redirect/e77579dc-8cb5-45e6-9602-4031f2d295b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," "[Florida Politics](https://substack.com/redirect/4873f5fb-d1fe-48f3-8954-d17ee6ee7453?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" and another Politico reporter (and friend of Caputo), Gary Fineout. Fineout was named in the Florida Power and Light[ scandal](https://substack.com/redirect/e77579dc-8cb5-45e6-9602-4031f2d295b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that led to multiple arrests. Caputo was named in the FPL scandal, as well.
There are long lists of people who likely appear in those lists, though many aren't raking in $100,000 a year. The DOJ reporting these accounts are working with Russia but not being transparent about which ones is frustrating. My hope is the DOJ is preparing indictments for all of the accounts they've identified and don't want to give any warning to the criminals.
For the sake of America, though, I hope that list becomes public soon. As I recently [showed,](https://substack.com/redirect/711d8ab0-cf06-4ae4-8490-b125cfee7113?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) social media is a system that exists to spread rumors and lies.
